origin: Port Authority casual labour pool — St. John's
delay_cause: Road congestion and reduced travel speed in wind conditions
workaround_description: On-site crew CRW-003 reassigned to priority securing tasks. Reduced throughput accepted.
notes: Minor delay. Core storm operations not gated on additional dock crew arrival.

delay_cause: Convoy reduced to 40 kph on Route 1 due to wind gusts and debris
workaround_description: Monitoring and isolation are the only options until the unit arrives.
notes: 4-hour delay acceptable in Scenario A — unit arrives before Scenario B peak. Pre-positioning enables rapid Scenario C response.

delay_cause: Route 1 single-lane due to fallen tree debris
workaround_description: Existing spill response trailer EQP-015 pre-positioned at SITE-06 plant gate provides adequate coverage.
notes: Low criticality. EQP-015 workaround is sufficient. Delay noted for recovery planning.

origin: Irving Oil Depot — Happy Valley-Goose Bay
delay_cause: Transport NL closed Labrador access road and all helicopter operations suspended
workaround_description: None available. Gen-C estimated 18 hours remaining at current load. Load-shedding of non-safety surface systems initiated immediately.
notes: Most critical delay in the dataset. If road does not open by 14:00 November 15 Gen-C fails. Comms rationing and load-shedding are the only mitigations.

delay_cause: Extreme wind closed Trans-Labrador Highway and suspended helicopter ops in ZONE-GRID
workaround_description: CRW-010 conducting remote diagnostics on Tower 14B. Can stabilize but cannot physically repair until crew arrives.
notes: Physical repair of Tower 14B deferred to Scenario C. Remote monitoring managing risk in the interim.

delay_cause: Route 1 closed between Clarenville and Holyrood — downed trees and debris
workaround_description: EQP-015 spill trailer at SITE-06 could be redeployed to SITE-02 but would remove coverage from Long Harbour.
notes: Boom breach at fuel pier creates containment gap. Redeploying EQP-015 is the only partial workaround — creates a coverage trade-off.

delay_cause: No helicopter window and road closed
workaround_description: CRW-012 is a trained first responder. Medical emergencies requiring hospital care would need air evacuation — also suspended.
notes: 142 personnel covered by one first responder. Reinforcement grounded. Scenario B highest medical risk period with no resupply.

delay_cause: Route 1 single-lane — convoy at 40 kph in wind and debris
workaround_description: Physical pole replacement cannot begin without hardware. Every hour of delay extends customer outage.
notes: 4-hour delay means approximately $152K additional outage cost for 18200 affected customers at $38K per hour.

origin: Irving Oil Depot — Happy Valley-Goose Bay
delay_cause: Road reopened but surface soft — reduced load capacity limits tanker speed
workaround_description: Gen-C has approximately 4 hours remaining at current load. Tanker dispatched at 11:45 — will arrive before critical fuel threshold.
notes: 2-hour slip manageable. Tight margin. Load-shedding remains active until resupply confirmed.

delay_cause: Post-storm road debris on Route 430 — single-lane traffic management
workaround_description: Tower 14B stable under remote monitoring. 3-hour delay acceptable given current tower stability.
notes: Minor delay in Scenario C. Crew on route and expected on-site at 11:00.

delay_cause: Roads clear — convoy arrived on schedule
workaround_description: No workaround needed — on time.
notes: Pre-positioned at depot during Scenario A enabled rapid dispatch. On-time arrival enables Scenario C repair to proceed on schedule.

resource_name: Temporary safety fencing and barrier materials
delay_cause: Small regional supplier — weekend hours limit dispatch capacity
workaround_description: Site fabrication team producing temporary barriers from on-hand materials. Surface restart not gated on this delivery.
notes: Low criticality. Does not affect critical path for Scenario C recovery operations at Voisey's Bay.

delay_cause: Route 100 slowed by crosswind and debris
workaround_description: Terminal seating and ferry lounge can cover short-duration shelter needs.
notes: Useful for passenger comfort but not on the critical path while ramp securing is completed.

delay_cause: High wind slows fuel truck dispatch over Route 230
workaround_description: Generator can support essential loads but non-critical shelter circuits may be shed if islanding lasts overnight.
notes: Pre-storm top-off delay increases Scenario B exposure if feeder isolation is required.

delay_cause: Extreme wind and causeway closure block travel to Argentia
workaround_description: Local team can keep ramp secured but cannot authorize passenger loading without inspection.
notes: Blocks any Scenario C passenger restart until engineering sign-off arrives.

delay_cause: Route 230 closed by whiteout and downed lines
workaround_description: Load-shed non-essential shelter circuits and preserve clinic refrigeration plus telecom node.
notes: If delivery slips past 09:00 the microgrid may need controlled load shedding before evening demand peak.

delay_cause: Coastal road flooding and wind restrictions
workaround_description: Reduce pump cycling and keep field operator on local telemetry watch until fuel arrives.
notes: Lift station still operating but fuel margin is thin if outage extends through the night.

delay_cause: Whiteout closes yard access road and supplier holds dispatch
workaround_description: Keep loading suspended and stage manual inspection after wind drops.
notes: Rail restart cannot proceed safely until heater module is replaced or bypass plan is approved.

delay_cause: Air cargo suspended and road transfer unavailable
workaround_description: Manual readings and satellite voice check-ins maintain minimum environmental reporting cadence.
notes: Manual monitoring is viable but increases reporting burden and fatigue risk.

delay_cause: Post-storm road debris slows travel to Argentia
workaround_description: Terminal remains closed to passenger loading until inspection completes.
notes: Short delay but high visibility because passengers and freight carriers are awaiting restart.

delay_cause: Road reopened with escort speed restrictions
workaround_description: Existing fuel covers current shelter load until delivery if non-essential circuits remain shed.
notes: Tanker arrival before noon restores overnight fuel margin.

delay_cause: Contractor crews clearing higher-priority highway debris first
workaround_description: CRW-028 can clear minor drift around loader bay while contractor handles rail approach.
notes: Delay affects restart efficiency but not life safety.

delay_cause: Low cloud ceiling postpones UAV launch window
workaround_description: Manual perimeter check and sensor calibration continue until drone window opens.
notes: Useful for assurance package but not blocking immediate manual environmental status report.
